# Generated by `cargo run -p agent_docs` from the diagnostic registry and compiler/tests/ui; do not edit.
title: "V2041 assign_captured_var"
description: "A lambda, or a try body, assigns to a var declared outside it."
---

An error from the `type` phase. `sakura explain V2041` prints this explanation offline.

A lambda, or a `try` body, assigns to a `var` declared outside it. Closures capture `var`s by
value, so the assignment would be lost (design §8.1); a `try` body's only outputs are its value
and its error (design §5.3). Use a loop with the `var` in the same function, or return the new
value and assign it afterwards.

Wrong:

```sakura
var n = 0
let r = try { n = parse(s)? }
```

Fixed:

```sakura
var n = 0
let r = try { parse(s)? }
n = r.unwrap_or(0)
```

## Wrong program

[`compiler/tests/ui/V2041_assign_captured_var.sak`](https://github.com/icantcodefyi/sakuralang/blob/main/compiler/tests/ui/V2041_assign_captured_var.sak), which the compiler's ui suite runs through `sakura check`:

```sakura
fn total() -> Int {
  var sum = 0
  let add = fn(x) { sum = sum + x }
  add(1)
  sum
}
```

## Fixed program

[`compiler/tests/ui/V2041_assign_captured_var.fixed.sak`](https://github.com/icantcodefyi/sakuralang/blob/main/compiler/tests/ui/V2041_assign_captured_var.fixed.sak), which `sakura check` accepts with no diagnostics:

```sakura
fn total() -> Int {
  var sum = 0
  for x in [1] { sum = sum + x }
  sum
}
```
